pose_landmarker_heavy.task: Google's MediaPipe Pose Landmarker (heavy, float16,
version 1), downloaded from
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_heavy/float16/1/pose_landmarker_heavy.task
on 2026-10-31 and copied unchanged (sha256 64437af838a65d18e5ba…). It replaced the lite model
(Carry 2.65.0), which misplaced the wrists in down-the-line swings. It is published under the terms of its
model card (BlazePose GHUM 3D), linked from
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker
Used here on one person's server; read the model card before sharing it further.

The SIMD build only: browsers without WebAssembly SIMD (iOS before 16.4) can't
run it, and Carry says so instead of measuring.
